text_en: Of the blue, purple, and crimson yarns they made finely worked vestments, for ministering in the holy place; they made the sacred vestments for Aaron; as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 以后用紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线，做了圣所内行礼穿的祭服，也做了为亚郎穿的圣衣，全照上主向梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: He made the ephod of gold, of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and of fine twisted linen.
text_cn: 用金线，紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线和捻的细麻，做了厄弗得，

text_en: Gold leaf was hammered out and cut into threads to work into the blue, purple, and crimson yarns and into the fine twisted linen, in skilled design.
text_cn: 就是将金子锤成了薄片，切成细线，以织工编织在紫色、红色、朱红色毛线和细麻之中。

text_en: They made for the ephod shoulder-pieces, joined to it at its two edges.
text_cn: 为厄弗得做了肩带结在厄弗得的两端，连结在一起。

text_en: The decorated band on it was of the same materials and workmanship, of gold, of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and of fine twisted linen; as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 那将厄弗得束在身上的带子像厄弗得一样做成，与厄弗得连在一起，是用金线，紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线和捻的细麻做成的，全按上主向梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: The onyx stones were prepared, enclosed in settings of gold filigree and engraved like the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the sons of Israel.
text_cn: 将两块红玛瑙石修好嵌在金框内，以刻印之法雕刻了以色列的儿子们的名字。

text_en: He set them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, to be stones of remembrance for the sons of Israel; as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 将金框安在厄弗得的肩带上，作为以色列子民的记念石，全照上主向梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: He made the breastpiece, in skilled work, like the work of the ephod, of gold, of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and of fine twisted linen.
text_cn: 又以绣工用金线，紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线及捻的细麻做了胸牌，像做厄弗得一样。

text_en: It was square; the breastpiece was made double, a span in length and a span in width when doubled.
text_cn: 做的胸牌是方形的，双层，一拃长，一拃宽。

text_en: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of carnelian, chrysolite, and emerald was the first row;
text_cn: 上面安装了四行宝石：第一行：赤玉、青玉、翡翠；

text_en: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and a moonstone;
text_cn: 第二行：紫宝石、蓝玉、金钢石；

text_en: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
text_cn: 第三行：黄玛瑙、白玛瑙、紫晶；

text_en: and the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper; they were enclosed in settings of gold filigree.
text_cn: 第四行：黄玉、红玛瑙、水苍玉：这些宝石都镶在金框内。

text_en: There were twelve stones with names corresponding to the names of the sons of Israel; they were like signets, each engraved with its name, for the twelve tribes.
text_cn: 宝石上有以色列的儿子们的名字，按他们的名字共十二块；按刻印的方法，每块刻上一个名字，代表十二支派。

text_en: They made on the breastpiece chains of pure gold, twisted like cords;
text_cn: 在胸牌上做了金的链子，像绳子一样拧成。

text_en: and they made two settings of gold filigree and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two edges of the breastpiece;
text_cn: 又做了两个金框和两个金环；将两个金环安在胸牌的两端。

text_en: and they put the two cords of gold in the two rings at the edges of the breastpiece.
text_cn: 将两条金链结在胸牌两端的环子上。

text_en: Two ends of the two cords they had attached to the two settings of filigree; in this way they attached it in front to the shoulder-pieces of the ephod.
text_cn: 把两条链子的另两端结在两框子上；把两框子结在厄弗得肩带的前面。

text_en: Then they made two rings of gold, and put them at the two ends of the breastpiece, on its inside edge next to the ephod.
text_cn: 又做了两个金环，安在胸牌下两端，靠近厄弗得的内边缘上。

text_en: They made two rings of gold, and attached them in front to the lower part of the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod, at its joining above the decorated band of the ephod.
text_cn: 还做了两个金环，安在厄弗得的前面肩带的下边，靠近厄弗得带子的上边与肩带相结连的地方。

text_en: They bound the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a blue cord, so that it should lie on the decorated band of the ephod, and that the breastpiece should not come loose from the ephod; as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 用一根紫绳，把胸牌的环子系在厄弗得的环子上，使胸牌结在厄弗得的带子上，免得胸牌在厄弗得上移动：全照上主向梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: He also made the robe of the ephod woven all of blue yarn;
text_cn: 以后又为厄弗得做了一件无袖长袍，是织成的，全为紫色。

text_en: and the opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening in a coat of mail, with a binding around the opening, so that it might not be torn.
text_cn: 长袍中间有一领口，像战袍的领口；领口周围镶上边，免得破裂。

text_en: On the lower hem of the robe they made pomegranates of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and of fine twisted linen.
text_cn: 又在长袍底边上，用捻的紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线做了石榴；

text_en: They also made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates on the lower hem of the robe all around, between the pomegranates;
text_cn: 又用纯金做了铃铛，将铃铛系在长袍底边周围的石榴中间，

text_en: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate all around on the lower hem of the robe for ministering; as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 如此在长袍底边周围，一个铃铛，一个石榴；一个铃铛，一个石榴，为行敬礼穿：全照上主向梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: They also made the tunics, woven of fine linen, for Aaron and his sons,
text_cn: 以后为亚郎和他的儿子们做了细麻长衣，是织成的。

text_en: and the turban of fine linen, and the headdresses of fine linen, and the linen undergarments of fine twisted linen,
text_cn: 也做了细麻的礼冠，细麻的华丽头巾，捻的细麻布裤子；

text_en: and the sash of fine twisted linen, and of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, embroidered with needlework; as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 又用捻的细麻及紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线编织了腰带：全按上主向梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: They made the rosette of the holy diadem of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engraving of a signet, “Holy to the Lord . ”
text_cn: 又用纯金做了圣冠上的牌子，在上面像雕刻印章，刻上了"祝圣于上主"。

text_en: They tied to it a blue cord, to fasten it on the turban above; as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 又用紫色绳子将这牌子系在礼冠上：全按上主向梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: In this way all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting was finished; the Israelites had done everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 帐棚、会幕的一切工程都完成了；凡上主向梅瑟所吩咐的，以色列子民都照做了。

text_en: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent and all its utensils, its hooks, its frames, its bars, its pillars, and its bases;
text_cn: 他们遂把帐棚运到梅瑟前，即帐幕和帐幕的一切用具：钩子、木板、横木、柱子、卯（mǎo）座，

text_en: the covering of tanned rams’ skins and the covering of fine leather, and the curtain for the screen;
text_cn: 染红的公山羊皮的顶罩，海豚皮的顶罩，作屏障的帐幔，

text_en: the ark of the covenant with its poles and the mercy seat;
text_cn: 约柜和杠杆，赎罪盖，

text_en: the table with all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;
text_cn: 供桌和桌上的一切用具，供饼，

text_en: the pure lampstand with its lamps set on it and all its utensils, and the oil for the light;
text_cn: 纯金的灯台与灯盏，即摆在灯台上的灯盏及其一切用具，灯油，

text_en: the golden altar, the anointing oil and the fragrant incense, and the screen for the entrance of the tent;
text_cn: 金祭坛，傅礼的油，韾香的香料，帐棚的门帘，

text_en: the bronze altar, and its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its utensils; the basin with its stand;
text_cn: 铜祭坛、祭坛的铜格子、杠杆和一切用具，盆和盆座，

text_en: the hangings of the court, its pillars, and its bases, and the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, and its pegs; and all the utensils for the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;
text_cn: 庭院的帷幔、柱子和卯（mǎo）座，庭院的门帘、绳子和橛子，以及一切为会幕圣所内使用的器皿；

text_en: the finely worked vestments for ministering in the holy place, the sacred vestments for the priest Aaron, and the vestments of his sons to serve as priests.
text_cn: 圣所内行礼的祭服，司祭亚郎的圣衣，和他儿子们尽司祭职的衣服：

text_en: The Israelites had done all of the work just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 以色列子民所作的一切工程，全是照上主向梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: When Moses saw that they had done all the work just as the Lord had commanded, he blessed them.
text_cn: 梅瑟查看了一切工程，见他们所行的，完全是照上主所吩咐的，遂祝福了他们。
